speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing fatigue, weight loss, and jaundice. To begin my assessment, have you noticed any changes in your urine color or stool appearance recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old male. The patient complains of persistent fatigue and reports poor sleep quality. He mentions adopting a vegetarian diet in recent months to improve his energy levels but hasn't noticed significant benefits. The patient reports losing weight without trying over the last month.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your age, unexplained weight loss, and fatigue despite dietary changes, I need to clarify the jaundice symptoms: have you noticed dark urine or pale stools?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have Poor sleep quality, Unintentional weight loss, Jaundice.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hepatocellular Carcinoma (or Metastatic Liver Disease).

Given your age, unintentional weight loss, fatigue, and jaundice, these are classic signs of advanced liver disease or primary liver cancer. Have you had any prior history of hepatitis, cirrhosis, or heavy alcohol use?

REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Panel, Alpha-Fetoprotein (AFP), Abdominal Ultrasound.

REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Imaging.
